author: ismailgalaxys25-del
description: ImgVX AI MCP server: finds the right free ImgVX AI browser tool for an image task (background remover, upscaler, object eraser, photo enhancer, compressor, resizer, converters) and returns a link. Hosted at https://imgvx.com/mcp, no API key.
name: ImgVX AI

tools.name: find_image_tool
tools.title: Find an ImgVX AI image tool
tools.description: Finds the free ImgVX AI browser tool for an image task the user describes, such as removing a background, upscaling, erasing an object, enhancing or colorizing a photo, compressing to a file size, resizing, cropping or converting HEIC, PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF. Returns matching tools with what each does, its price (most are free) and a link to open it. This tool does not edit images itself: the user opens the link and edits the image in their own browser.

task.description: What the user wants to do to their image, in a few words (e.g. "remove background", "make photo 4x bigger", "compress to 100 KB").

language.description: Optional: the user's language, for a link to the page in that language where one exists.

annotations.title: Find an ImgVX AI image tool

tools.name: list_image_tools
tools.title: List ImgVX AI tools
tools.description: Lists every ImgVX AI image tool, optionally in one category, with a short description and a link.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: ImgVX AI pricing
tools.description: Returns what is free on ImgVX AI and what Pro and the credit packs cost.
